Extractor_notes: Absolute effect only, so Effect_pct left blank: residential NO2 fell -3.77 ug/m3 per year in London vs -1.77 ug/m3 per year in Luton (comparator town without a clean air zone), p<0.0001, implying about -2.0 ug/m3 per year faster decline in the ULEZ arm. Years = midpoint of about 4-year follow-up from Apr 2019
